articles.title: Newfound clouds of missing ‘ordinary’ matter sit outside galaxies
articles.snippet: Dark matter isn’t the universe’s only “missing” matter. Distant bursts of radio waves have now turned up vast, faint gas clouds surrounding galaxies.
articles.summary: Scientists have found huge, faint gas clouds surrounding galaxies using distant bursts of radio waves. This discovery helps account for some of the universe's missing ordinary matter.

articles.title: Scientists Say: Blood Falls
articles.snippet: This five-story-tall waterfall in Antarctica gets its blood-red color from the same reaction that creates rust.
articles.summary: A tall waterfall in Antarctica has a striking blood-red color. This red color is caused by the same chemical reaction that makes rust.

articles.title: In the heat, this Death Valley shrub air conditions its leaves
articles.snippet: Leaves of the Arizona honeysweet can turn on evaporative cooling to keep the plant up to 13 degrees C (23 degrees F) cooler than the surrounding air.
articles.summary: The Arizona honeysweet shrub uses evaporative cooling to air condition its leaves. This process can keep the plant up to 13 degrees Celsius cooler than the surrounding air.
